critical_code_review_comments: Gate order in POST /admin/github/bulk-revoke correctly orders: dry_run preview -> hard_guard -> live_verified -> rate limit -> reason_required. This means when the live flag is OFF (current state), a real-revoke request missing 'reason' returns 403 live_verification_pending instead of 400 reason_required — this matches the spec ('should never mask those other error codes for requests that don't supply a reason'). Once flag is flipped ON in prod, the reason_required 400 becomes reachable (already unit-tested with monkeypatch).

AdminGithubBulkRevoke.jsx line 118 uses a ternary as a statement (next.has(iid) ? next.delete(iid) : next.add(iid)) — works but is a lint-unfriendly pattern; consider `if/else` for clarity. Non-blocking.
